caption: The drawing features a single, centrally placed object that resembles a chalice or goblet. The object is symmetrically composed and rendered in grayscale, with shading used to depict the cylindrical cup, the tapered and intricately contoured stem, and the wide, stepped base. The goblet appears metallic due to the smooth gradations of gray. The drawing is enclosed within a larger rectangular border, also outlined in pencil or ink. The background within the border is plain, with no additional objects or patterns, and the paper shows some signs of aging, evident in faint brownish areas. A signature, “A. Herrera,” appears in the bottom right corner inside the border.
title: Lamp
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
